drafts.text:
For a new connection the security deposit is required according to the rates approved by NEPRA and listed in Annex‑IV. The rates are per kilowatt of load and differ by consumer type, for example Residential A‑1 Urban = Rs. 1,220/kW, Residential A‑1 Rural = Rs. 610/kW, Commercial A‑2 Urban = Rs. 1,810/kW, etc. [S5][S6]  

The sources do not provide any information about connection‑charge amounts for a new connection. NOT_FOUND.
